senses.gloss:
Up,Ⓒprep., adv.Ⓓut prefixed; UrDvaM, upari, uccEH; ‘up to’, See Till; ApradAnAt ‘up to being given away’ APalodayakarmaRAM &c.; ‘be up and doing’ kAryavyagro Bava; ‘ups and downs’ pAtotpAtAH; See Down.
Ⓝ[Up]per,Ⓒa.Ⓓuparitana (nI f.), upari-sTa, UrDva, uttara; ‘to get the u(pper)-hand’ aBi-BU 1 P, atiric pass.; See Excel.
